d: Nitish setu ke udghatan karyakram men nitish kumar ke shamil hone ko lekar bihar ki rajniti men bayanbaji tej ho gaee hai. rashtriy janta dal (RJD) dvara kie ja rahe davon aur chunauti ke bich janta dal yunaited (JDU) yah spasht nahin kar paee ki nitish kumar kal pradhanmantri narendr modi ke karyakram men jaenge ya nahin, jismen nitish setu ka udghatan hona hai.
